text.en: 1. This Order is the Environmental Public Health (Designation of Specified Premises) Order 2021 and comes into operation on 30 July 2021.

3.—(1) Each class of premises specified in the first column of the Schedule is, with effect from and including the corresponding date specified in the second column of that Schedule, designated under section 62A(2) of the Act as specified premises.
(2) An Environmental Control Coordinator must be appointed for any specified premises described in the Schedule.
